scientific_integrity: The contradiction is analytic: the update-map Jacobian has multipliers \(0,0,\alpha_0\), and an explicit admissible parameter choice has the exact one-step contraction \(V_{n+1}\le(3/4)V_n\) on a positive neighborhood. Finite computation is used only to replay exact rational inequalities.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the printed discrete map and disproves its universal permanence statement by a local positive basin. It does not classify all invariant sets or all basins, and it does not address modified models in which \(G\) feeds back into \(H\) or \(P\).
title: A positive basin at the origin invalidates permanence in the PTM host–parasitoid map
